definitions.gloss: rime ice on trees; frost-covered trees; ice monsters
definitions.explanation: A natural phenomenon where supercooled water droplets freeze on contact with tree branches, coating them in layers of white ice. Creates dramatic, sculptural formations that are a popular winter tourist attraction in Japan.

notes:
A compound of {樹|じゅ} (tree) and {氷|ひょう} (ice). The most famous {樹氷|じゅひょう} in Japan are found at {蔵王|ざおう} in Yamagata Prefecture, where they are nicknamed {樹氷|じゅひょう}⟦モンスター→モンスター：12842_monsutaa⟧ or "snow monsters" (⟦アイス→アイス：06770_aisu⟧⟦モンスター→モンスター：12842_monsutaa⟧). They form when strong winds carry supercooled water droplets from the Sea of Japan onto mountain trees.
